THESIS_STATEMENT: Although wearable fitness devices can help students become more aware of their sleep and exercise habits, this essay argues that they should be used carefully because their benefits are limited by weak long-term behavior change, privacy concerns, and possible stress.
AI should be integrated into education.
School uniforms can support people's lives really well.
Club activities do not automatically raise academic performance, but they should be encouraged.
Convenience stores remain important in urban and low-access neighborhoods because they save time, support local food access, and can serve community needs.

Video games should be viewed as a potentially beneficial activity when they are played in moderation, because they can support cognitive skills and social relationships, but they also require limits when gaming begins to interfere with sleep, school, or healthy routines.
However, this essay will argue that music festivals are essential for the community.
